To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the more accurate sampled data model is derived, the sampling zero dynamics is derived, and a condition which assures stability of the zero-dynamics of the more accurate model is derived.
a sampled-data controller can be designed using a continuous-time model if the sampling zero dynamics is stable.
a more accurate sampled-data models of a continuous-time plant is derived and the stability of sampling zero dynamics of it is discussed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the derivation of a sampled-data model which is more accurate than that proposed by Yuz and GoodWin, and a condition which assures that the sampling zero dynamics is stable.
the derivation of a good sampled-data model for sampled-data controller design and the stability of the sampled-data model.
the derivation of the sampling zero dynamic of a more accurate sampled-data nonlinear model and a condition for the stability of the model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the more accurate sampled data model has the same sampling zero dynamics as those of the approximate sampled-data model when the relative degree is two and the sampling zero dynamics are stable.
the stability of the closed-loop sampled-data system is assured if the sampling zero dynamics corresponding to each relative degree of a nonlinear plant are stable.

the sampling zero dynamics for the more accurate sampled data model is stable if the relative degree of nonlinear continuous-time plants is two or greater and the zero dynamics of the nonlinear system is stable.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have derived an accurate sampled-data model which includes the sampling zero dynamics for a class of nonlinear plants and we have also shown a condition to assure the stability of the extra zero dynamics.
the sampling zero dynamics is a good tool to evaluate the stability of the sampled-data model.
the stability of sampling zero dynamics is a key to the controller design for nonlinear systems based on the sampled-data model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the sampling zero dynamics is stable for the more accurate sampled data model when the continuous-time plant is minimum phase.

the stability of the more accurate approximate sampled-data model is assured when the continuous-time nonlinear plant satisfies a condition that its relative degree is two and its second order time derivative is Lipschitz.
the sampling zero dynamics is stable if the continuous-time zero dynamics of the nonlinear system is stable.
